## Dear Neighbors,
Oakland has been my home for 25 years. As an OUSD parent, PTA leader, and Bay Area native, I know strong public schools are essential to our children and our community. That’s why I’m running for School Board in District 4.
You deserve accountable, collaborative leadership and a clear path to financial stability and high-quality education.
With over 20 years of experience in financial services, compliance, regulatory affairs, and a Master of Public Affairs from UC Berkeley's Goldman School of Public Policy, I’m ready to put that experience to work in service of our schools and the next generation.
I’d be honored to earn your vote.
Kathryn Camp
